declarations.source: Version 2.0 (2026-11-07, HTL-24 row 223, ruled 2026-11-07) - the major version, by R-0007 ('Backward-compatible field additions only ... Migration path documented before breaking changes') and 1.3's 'removed at the next major version'. It carries 1.5's trace_id pattern and removes policy_refs. $id is v2 and schema_version takes v2.{minor}. Migration: set schema_version to v2.0 (both SDKs build it); drop policy_refs, which nothing read (a v2 envelope carrying it is refused as an undefined field, naming it, as at 1.4); send action, never tool_name: the alias 1.1 took leaves at 2.0 (gap row 225, ruled 2026-11-08), so an envelope carrying tool_name is refused as an undefined field, naming action, and a policy condition on tool_name is refused by the lint, naming action; give trace_id in W3C Trace Context's form, or move another id to correlation_id (1.5). An envelope carrying a v1 schema_version is refused (VALIDATION_ERROR / ENVELOPE_VALIDATION_ERROR in the hosted service, the core model's error in an SDK), naming the version it carries, the version taken and this note: no acceptance window, no dual handling. Records written before 2.0 are held as written and are not read again against this schema (Principle 6). Version 1.5 (2026-11-06, HTL-23 row 210, ruled 2026-11-06) - trace_id takes the pattern ^[0-9a-f]{32}$, W3C Trace Context's form, in place of maxLength 128. A breaking change, entered by its migration path: an envelope whose trace_id is in another form is refused (VALIDATION_ERROR / ENVELOPE_VALIDATION_ERROR in the hosted service, the core model's error in an SDK), naming trace_id. The SDKs set trace_id only from the active span (HTL-22 row 175), so a client of this SDK release sends no other form; a caller that builds its own envelope and puts its own id in trace_id moves that id to correlation_id, which takes it as given (1 to 128 characters). Records written before 1.5 are held as written and are not read again against this schema (Principle 6). Version 1.4 (2026-11-04, R-0872) - cost_estimate is closed: an undefined key is refused, naming it, as at the top level. Version 1.3 (2026-10-10) - policy_refs deprecated: accepted, ignored, removed at the next major version; the envelope never names the policies that apply. Version 1.2 (2026-10-08, T-130 A7) - added principal, the verified principal. Version 1.1 - Renamed tool_name to action. Made operation/target/parameters optional with defaults. Backward compatibility: tool_name accepted as alias for action. Language-neutral. All implementations must validate against this schema.
